column1: # Upstream zeron -> Roboco rename map. The ONE table the upstream tools use.
# It mirrors AGENTS.md "Porting from zeron" -> "Rename mapping" and "Rebrand
# boundaries"; tests/test_rename_map.py checks every pair AGENTS.md lists.
# kind      what it does (applied in this order)
# protect   token kept verbatim everywhere (masked before any rewrite)
# regex     Python regex replacement, applied to file text after protect
# text      literal replacement, applied to file text and paths, in file order
# path      directory prefix rewrite, first match wins, applied before `text`
# verbatim  path prefix whose file text is never rewritten (paths still map)
